receipts.first_text_witness: Picture this. You're 43-years old. It's a Tuesday night, the kids are finally in bed, and you do something you've been quietly avoiding for about 6 months. You log into your retirement account, you stare at the number, and then you just sit there.
receipts.last_text_witness: of them will make a good Instagram post. You're not going to go viral for checking your beneficiary designations or bumping your 401k contribution by 1%, but in 25 years when the second version of you is sitting across from the first version, the one who meant to, but didn't, you'll know exactly which decisions made the difference. Make them now while the math still gives you a fighting chance.
